description: Source code for a Zephyr-based USB Ethernet Control Model (ECM) function implementation, handling USB descriptors, endpoints, and communication for a network-over-USB device.

methods.name: ecm_get_first_iface_number
methods.description: Returns the first interface number for the ECM configuration.

methods.name: ecm_class_handler
methods.description: Handles USB setup requests specific to ECM class.

methods.name: ecm_status_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling USB status changes.

methods.name: ecm_interface_config
methods.description: Configures interface descriptors and string descriptors for ECM.

methods.name: ecm_connect
methods.description: Handles connection and disconnection events for the ECM interface.

methods.name: ecm_read_cb
methods.description: Callback for receiving data from USB endpoint.

methods.name: ecm_status_interface
methods.description: Enables ECM media when interface is active.
